---
name: repo-map
description: Use before large repo changes, unfamiliar codebases, architecture questions, or multi-file edits.
---

Build minimal map:
1. Identify entry points.
2. Identify files directly related to task.
3. Read only those files first.
4. Summarize architecture in ≤10 bullets.
5. Propose edit plan.
6. Do not scan whole repo unless necessary.
